env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A tuple operand in parentheses keeps its parentheses paired with the
# operand when a block comment sits inside them, after the opening
# parenthesis or before the closing one. The module runs natively, ejects,
# and the ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^3 <nil> 3 <nil> 1 2 1 2 5 6 1 2 5 6$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tupleparen

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type S struct{ t (int, int) }

func pair() (int, error) { return 3, nil }

func pass(t (int, int)) (int, int) {
	return ((t /* inner */) /* outer */)
}

func lead(t (int, int)) (int, int) {
	return ( /* before */ t)
}

func field(s S) (int, int) {
	return ((s.t /* inner */) /* outer */)
}

func main() {
	t := (pair() /* comment */)
	a, b := t
	u := (( /* lead */ pair() /* inner */) /* outer */)
	c, d := u
	x, y := (pass((1, 2)) /* comment */)
	var m, n int
	m, n = (x, y /* inner */)
	s := S{t: (5, 6)}
	p, q := ((s.t /* inner */) /* outer */)
	g, h := lead((1, 2))
	k, l := field(s)
	fmt.Println(a, b, c, d, m, n, x, y, p, q, g, h, k, l)
}
